newsitem.title: MEXICO: Abaco says negotiating foreign alliance.
newsitem.headline: Abaco says negotiating foreign alliance.

text.p: Financial group Abaco is holding talks with several foreign banks to inject capital into its banking division, said Adrian Gonzalez, corporate relations director at the group.
"Indeed we are working on raising capital. There is no cut and dried scheme, but the possibilities include partnerships with foreign investors," Gonzalez said in a telephone interview.
Gonzalez said foreign capital may be chanelled into a specific market niche, such as setting up and running a Retirement Investment Fund (Afore)
"We are thinking of taking part in Afores with foreign firms or banks and insurance companies," he said.
